name: Endow Ki (Ki)
body:
You can share the power of your ki with another.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can spend 2 points from your ki pool to endow an ally you touch with a portion of your ki. Your ally gains a temporary ki pool of 1 point and the use of any one ki feat you know for a number of minutes equal to your Wisdom bonus or until they expend the 1 point in their ki pool.

This feat has no effect on a creature that already possesses a ki pool (including a temporary ki pool), and its effects do not stack.
